name: one-minute-pr
description: Pushes the branch and opens a pull request whose body a human reviewer can judge in one minute. The body uses fixed sections (Why, What changed, Scope, Tradeoffs, Blast Radius, Rollback, Verification) and only evidence the agent has seen. It selects visuals for the change, including language-tagged code examples, flow diagrams, and UI captures. A bundled script fails the body on a wrong section order, a missing Scope or Rollback, an HTML comment, long dashes, curly quotes, or mid-sentence colons outside code. Works in Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity.
